notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Last week I mentioned I would post a road map for the coming weeks/months. I would like to take a moment to do this now. At the moment, this is my list of things I want to get added to the game:
• Bounty Board / Random events tied to bounty hunting
• Prison and Courtroom areas for crime related random events
• Profile Customization / Cosmetic rewards
• Election Process / features for those elected
• Enemy factions / quest line for hostile elected ruler
• Mercenary Synergies / mercenary balance around player verse player combat
• Raid Content
• Additional crafting options
• Bestiary / Game Manual
• Better Tutorial / New Player Help

[h3]January[/h3]
As of now, the bounty system and a few of the random events are ready. I was hoping I would have more complete and ready, but this is not the case. Player verse player content is tied to the bounty system, so I will work to get mercenary combat balanced out this week so I can release an update by the end of the month. Also in development, players will soon be able to earn cosmetic rewards that can be displayed on their player profiles. More details will be released concerning these at a future time.

[h3]February[/h3]
For the month of February, I plan to develop and release the Election process. The whole point of the game is to become a sovereign elect, and this will finally be added to the game during February. Because I've dragged by feet getting the reputation system going, everything else has had to wait. I suppose there was so much to work on, I simply got overwhelmed. By the end of February, I'm hoping the election systems are all in and functioning as desired.

[h3]March[/h3]
For the month of March, any additional content that I has come up in development will be worked on. A bestiary or guide book of information will need to be added to the game. Also, more help for new players.

notes.title: Patch v.0.0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3]
• fixed an error displaying equipment loading into game.
• fixed an error loading cursor tool stats.
• fixed influence mark ability to function correctly.
• fixed mercenary holding equipment to display it properly.
• fixed an error where merit was not counted for certain areas for quests.
• fixed an error where equipment given to mercenaries wouldn't register for quest.
• fixed a sound error when obtaining resources from fields.
• fixed an error where a certain quest would swap quest givers.
• fixed an error where rewards displayed incorrectly.
• fixed a display error with courtyard of blades activities.
• fixed quests for blacksmith quest giver - Also to note, the blacksmith says you can buy equipment slots from him, but this feature currently isn't available yet.

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
• a number of sounds missing/not working.
• hover text for a number of activities not working
• switching groups can cause issues with mercenary placement

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
• Added a redeemable code "basic" - gives 5 basic mercenary scrolls. - To redeem a code, select the system tab and input the code.

notes.title: Small Patch Fixes
notes.notes:
During the day, you may experience a patch or two. With the game now available for early access, a number of bugs have been reported that need addressing. Ideally the game will receive a patch every few days. This is the desired schedule moving forward.

Patched items:
• Multiplayer icons don't always reset when a player is online/offline. This is resulting in avatars and mercenaries not loading when the icon is selected. A fix has been added in hopes to solve this issue.
• Fixed a calculation error for mercenary gathering and converting rates.
• As of now, a 'guide' button has been added at the bottom right corner of the game. This will reference a short guide I written up to help introduce the game interface. 

Current bugs found:
• Although the game autosaves, there are instances where things do not save. This is being looked into.

If there are questions, concerns, feedback, please share your thoughts in the discussion board. Thank you.

notes.title: Demo v.2.3 Patch
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes for v.2.3.

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
* Added glove visual effects for gathering mastery.
* Tool is more responsive and the activity icons do a subtle shake animation when mastery is obtained.
* Enemies shake when taking damage.
* Added an indicator for when mercenaries are resting.
* Added a couple [i]QoL[/i] changes to the redeem code feature. Enter, Backspace, and Ctrl+V can be used to input codes easier.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
* Fixed a bug that kept mercenaries in groups 2+ from being tracked/saved.
* Fixed a bug that kept mercenaries from speaking.
* Fixed a crash that happens rarely when leaving an area with an enemy encounter present.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
Will be adding more items next patch that can be redeemed by code for use/testing. In the next patch or two, a new location will be added to the demo.

notes.title: Demo v2 Patch
notes.notes:
These are the patch notes for update v.2.0.

[h2]Mercenary Voices[/h2]
* Alchemist voices have been added.
* Bounty Hunter voices have been added.
* Fury voices have been added.
* Paladin voices have been added.
* Priest voices have been added.
* Proctor voices have been added.
* Royal Guard voices have been added.
* Seer voices have been added.
* Assassin voices have been added.
* Buccaneer voices have been added.
* Cleric voices have been added.
* Enchanter voices have been added.
* Knight voices have been added.
* Warlock voices have been added.

* Mercenaries have a voice line for when you 1) start the game, 2) give them an item, 3) when they level up, 4) when they take damage, 5) when they are prestiged. There is RNG for some of the voice lines to not toggle, to prevent mercenaries from talking too much. 
* Only mercenaries visible on screen can talk. [i]If there are subtitles but no audio, this is a bug.[/i]

[h2]Misc Fixes[/h2]
* Prestiged mercenaries now save.
* Prestige multipliers now apply the appropriate stat buff [i](x1.5 attack,gather,conversion stats)[/i]
* Mercenary gloves move with their portrait counterpart when their group is toggled.
* Mercenary ability icons that appear will display their appropriate text while hovered. [i]Note that not all the abilities themselves are feature complete yet, so some abilities will do nothing when collected.[/i]
* The 'Hireling' mercenary tag is changed to white, while the rare mercenaries names are grey.
* When giving an item to a mercenary, the popup will display the correct number of items needed for the next level up if you have more than the required amount
* Also adjusted the checkmark to give 1 item by default while the textbox is left blank
* Display for coins disappearing has been slowed to give the player more time to collect them.
* Quests now track mercenaries in all groups instead of the first and second. Levels should now be tracked as well.
* The game will auto save roughly every minute, and it will also save when a new mercenary is added/changed.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
I did not add 'beers' or 'coffees' due to them being area locked. Also, it will require a new save file, which will crash the game if you were to start over. [i](you would have to manually delete your file to prevent the crash)[/i] Instead, I am making the transition to have all the save data the steam database. This will take some time, but once finished, all the testing will take place on the main application instead of the demo.

As for other things, I am finalizing abilities and prestige buffs for all the characters and will be added next patch. I will release a code to give temporary items for testing purposes when this rolls out.

notes.title: Demo v.1.8 Patch
notes.notes:
These are the patch notes for 6/17/24's update. (v.1.8)

[h2]Quests[/h2]
* Fixed quest tracking so do not reset when another one is turned in.
* Fixed a bug where progress from a previous quest would show even though the quest was turned in.
* Hand of the King's 2nd quest tracks items/mercenary levels now.
[h2]Abilities[/h2]
* Haste Coin has a sound and applies corrected multipliers.
* Frost Ability Coin has an animation/sound but does not do anything as of yet.
* Blast and Boost Coins have an animation/sound and corrected multipliers.
* Rage Ability Coin has a sound.
[h2]Other[/h2]
* Group numbers at bottom right of screen update at start of the game.
* Fixed an error regarding group 2 mercenaries appearing/disappearing.
* Inventory menu slider appears when there are 6 unique items in your inventory.
* Guild Scroll visual effect added.
* Added sound for gifting your mercenaries.
* Added a 'Prestiged' name plate so you know if your mercenary is prestiged or not.
* Changed a few miscellaneous sprites to draw correctly as intended.

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
At the moment there are a lot of issues with mercenary audio working/not working that is being looked into. Coming next, mercenary voices, stats, and abilities are being added. Currently working on Epic tier mercenaries, and will move to legendary and mythic after. Event mercenaries available at the moment will be added as well.
